title: The Vow Carried
subtitle: devotion on an ordinary day
mapEpigraph: A true vow is not luggage.

prompts.text: Where did your hand find the stone today?
Which ordinary choice shifted, even slightly?
Carrying the vow today, what shifted?

blocks.title: The stone in the pocket
blocks.instruction: Carry a small stone or another ordinary object. Let it stand for one line of the vow. Capture in the evening.

blocks.closing: Sleep with the vow nearby. Tomorrow is the crossing.
